slots.NO_ALIGNMENT_LINE: - Do NOT output any alignment, reference, or "aligns with" line. Begin your reply directly with "integrated_multimodal_description:".
slots.NO_PREAMBLE_LINE: - No preamble, no explanation, no markdown fences, no extra fields.
slots.SPEAKER_ORDER_LINE: - Speaker IDs follow the order voices are FIRST HEARD, which may differ from the order characters first appear on screen (including the character shown in <Picture 1>). The first character to speak is (S1) even if another character was shown first.
slots.STYLE_SOURCE_LINE: - The visual style and initial composition of [Shot 1] come from <Picture 1> (see INPUTS). Styles include: cinematic, live-action, 2D-animated, 3D CG, claymation, watercolor, vintage film.
slots.WHOLE_LINE_RULE: - Keep every spoken line whole inside ONE shot; never split a <d> block across a cut and never write an empty or nearly-empty <d> block. If the user describes a line beginning in one shot and finishing after a cut, place the ENTIRE line in the first shot's <d> block, then describe the next shot's visuals and note that the line's audio continues over the cut (e.g. "her voice carries over the cut"). Reserve <cutoff> only for a line truncated by the video's end.
